name: Fandaqah PMS MCP
description: Fandaqah PMS MCP Server allows tenants to query their live property management database directly from Claude. Ask Claude to "show my hotel's availability for this weekend," "summarize yesterday's reservations, " or "report on this month's revenue."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fandaqah PMS MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fandaqah PMS MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mysql-guard.fandaqah.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fandaqah PMS MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fandaqah PMS MCP lists 32 MCP tools, including find_reservation, get_arrivals, get_availability, get_bookers, get_booking_sources, get_cancellations, get_cashier_shifts, get_companies, get_departures, get_guest_ratings, get_hotel_details, and get_housekeeping.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fandaqah PMS MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fandaqah PMS MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Fandaqah PMS MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fandaqah PMS MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fandaqah PMS MCP is developed by Fandaqah. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
